title: Infrastructure Truth Reconciliation
objective: Reconcile deployment truth across the live Azure Container App runtime, deployment manifests, docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, azure/container-app.yaml, public bridge status, and local operational assumptions.
tasks: Export current live Container App configuration.
Compare target ports, ingress, env vars, runtime assumptions, health routes, and revision posture.
Identify scaffold-only configuration, stale deployment assumptions, and runtime/documentation drift.
Produce Infrastructure Truth Report, Canonical Runtime Map, and recommended authoritative deployment source.
Preserve fail-closed posture, governed execution continuity, and no-bypass execution.
rules: Treat live runtime as authoritative unless proven otherwise.
Do not expose secret values in generated reports.
validation: az containerapp show --name ca-nc-dev-sentinel --resource-group rg-nc-dev-sentinel -o json
